title: Head and Hand
label: ch:ml-head-and-hand
canDo: I can name the head and the hand in Malayalam.

payoff.summary: Say thala and kai, and match them against Tamil's talai and kai.
payoff.note: Below the 0.5 floor by sequence, not by omission: ML-C13-shareera-bhaagangal (410) is the chapter's only spoken lesson and assesses its own atom. The other two, ML-SCRIPT-RECOG-08 (ML-S08-letter-ta, 415) and ML-SCRIPT-RECOG-117 (ML-S117-letter-tta, 416), are taught by script-delivery lessons sequenced after it, so the payoff cannot honestly assess them and neither script lesson is a fitting payoff for head and hand.
